title: Breaker-point ignition: reading dwell and when to replace the points
summary: Which way to move the point gap when dwell is off, and the wear limit for point contacts. Applies to any breaker-point distributor.

specs.name: Dwell below specification
specs.note: Close the gap to raise dwell

specs.name: Dwell above specification
specs.note: Open the gap to lower dwell

specs.name: Replace the point set when
specs.value: Contacts are badly burned, or metal transfer equals or exceeds the gap setting

specs.name: Point resistance
specs.value: Must be within the manufacturer's specification

sources.title: Construction Mechanic, Engine Tune-Up I, 8-7 (Military Curriculum Materials for Vocational and Technical Education, ERIC ED 223 904)
sources.publisher: Naval Construction Training Center, Port Hueneme, Calif., 1978
sources.citation: Outline of Instruction, 'Check and test breaker points', sheet 7 of 15
